extraction_notes: Revenue Deficit and Primary Deficit are reported as 0 because the state had a surplus in 2017-18, as indicated in Table 1.3 (page 20), Chart 1.4 (page 21), Chart 1.30 (page 62), and the Conclusion (page 66). Capital Outlay as % of GSDP and Revenue Receipts as % of GSDP were calculated from absolute figures provided in the report (Capital Outlay: 10,353 crore from Table 1.2 page 19; Revenue Receipts: 48,512 crore from Table 1.4 page 22; GSDP: 1,40,887 crore from Table 1.1 page 17). The 'raised_this_year' for audit paras refers to the number of grants/appropriations where excess expenditure occurred in 2017-18 (Table 2.2, page 71). 'outstanding_over_5_years' and 'pac_recommendations_pending' were not explicitly found. 'money_value_of_observations_crore' refers to the aggregate excess expenditure requiring regularization as on 31 March 2018 (page 71).
